in_sanskrit.name: Falguniya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of spring
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Falguniya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Falguniya is a Sanskrit name derived from Falgun, the Hindu goddess of spring. The name represents the joy, warmth, and renewal that comes with the arrival of spring. Falguniya is also believed to symbolize the victory of good over evil, as the goddess is known to vanquish the demon of winter.
